general_information.Description: This course is intended for researchers and business experts seeking state-of-the-art knowledge in advanced science and technology. The course covers details on Big Data (Hadoop, Spark, Storm), Smartphones, Smart Watches, Android, iOS, CPU/GPU/SoC, Mobile Communications (1G to 5G), Sensors, IoT, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, LP-WAN, Cloud Computing, AR (Augmented Reality), Skype, YouTube, H.264/MPEG-4 AVC, MPEG-DASH, CDN, and Video Streaming Services. The Specialization includes projects on Big Data using IBM SPSS Statistics, AR applications, Cloud Computing using AWS (Amazon Web Service) EC2 (Elastic Compute Cloud), and Smartphone applications to analyze mobile communication, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth networks.
general_information.StudentTasks: 1. Complete the online courses and get all course certifications to be allowed to take Final Exam 2. Final Exam included Final Theory Exam (TE): 100% 3. Student gets 0.33 bonus points for each course completed on time. 4. Completion Criteria: Final TE Score >=4 & (Final TE Score + bonus) >= 5 5. In the case: (5 > Final TE Score >=4) & (Final TE Score + bonus) < 5, the student can choose to take the resit of TE.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Explain basis concepts in big data, architectural components and programming models used for scalable big data analysis.
Collect, store and organize data using big data solutions
Design a big data information system for small company
Execute simple big data integration and processing on Hadoop and Spark platforms
